story.iWant: the Next.js 15 project scaffolded with all core dependencies installed
story.soThat: I have a consistent, configured development environment to build upon

task.name: Create Next.js 15 project
task.subtask: 1.1: Execute npx create-next-app@latest marmorani --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir
1.2: Verify TypeScript strict mode is enabled in tsconfig.json
1.3: Confirm src/ directory structure is created
1.4: Test npm run dev starts successfully

task.name: Configure TypeScript & ESLint
task.subtask: 2.1: Add path aliases to tsconfig.json (@/components/*, @/lib/*, @/stores/*, @/hooks/*, @/types/*, @/constants/*, @/actions/*)
2.2: Verify ESLint configuration passes with npm run lint

task.name: Install UI dependencies
task.subtask: 3.1: Initialize shadcn/ui: npx shadcn@latest init
3.2: Select "New York" style, slate base color, CSS variables enabled
3.3: Verify shadcn/ui components directory created at src/components/ui/

task.name: Install 3D rendering dependencies
task.subtask: 4.1: Install Three.js ecosystem: npm install three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei && npm install -D @types/three
4.2: Verify TypeScript recognizes Three.js types

task.name: Install database & auth dependencies
task.subtask: 5.1: Install Prisma and Supabase: npm install @prisma/client @supabase/supabase-js && npm install -D prisma
5.2: Initialize Prisma with npx prisma init
5.3: Verify prisma/schema.prisma created

task.name: Install state management
task.subtask: 6.1: Install Zustand: npm install zustand

task.name: Install form & validation dependencies
task.subtask: 7.1: Install form libraries: npm install react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod

task.name: Install i18n dependencies
task.subtask: 8.1: Install next-intl: npm install next-intl

task.name: Install payment dependencies
task.subtask: 9.1: Install Stripe: npm install stripe @stripe/stripe-js

task.name: Install email dependencies
task.subtask: 10.1: Install Resend and React Email: npm install resend && npm install -D react-email @react-email/components

task.name: Install PDF generation
task.subtask: 11.1: Install @react-pdf/renderer: npm install @react-pdf/renderer

task.name: Install utility dependencies
task.subtask: 12.1: Install utilities: npm install date-fns clsx tailwind-merge

task.name: Create environment template
task.subtask: 13.1: Create .env.example with all required keys (DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL)
13.2: Add descriptive comments for each variable

task.name: Configure next.config.ts
task.subtask: 14.1: Configure image optimization domains
14.2: Add any required transpilePackages

task.name: Create lib utilities
task.subtask: 15.1: Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() helper (clsx + tailwind-merge)
15.2: Create src/lib/prisma.ts singleton (placeholder for Story 1.2)

task.name: Final verification
task.subtask: 16.1: Run npm run dev - verify starts without errors
16.2: Run npm run build - verify builds successfully
16.3: Run npm run lint - verify no linting errors
16.4: Verify all dependencies in package.json

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A Next.js 15 App Router project is created with TypeScript strict mode enabled, Tailwind CSS configured, ESLint configured, and src/ directory structure

All core dependencies are installed and configured per the Architecture document: shadcn/ui, React Three Fiber + Drei, Prisma ORM, Supabase client, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, next-intl, Stripe, Resend + React Email, @react-pdf/renderer, date-fns, clsx, tailwind-merge
Environment variable template (.env.example) is created with all required keys documented
Path aliases are configured in tsconfig.json (@/components, @/lib, etc.)
npm run dev starts without errors

code.note: Greenfield project: Story 1.1 initializes the entire codebase from scratch. No existing code artifacts.

constraints.constraint: Next.js 15 App Router with Server Components by default for optimal performance.
TypeScript strict mode MUST be enabled for type safety across codebase.
src/ directory structure required - all application code in src/ for clean organization.
Path aliases configured: @/* maps to ./src/* for clean imports.
shadcn/ui "New York" style with slate base color and CSS variables enabled.
No secrets committed to repository. Use .env.local for actual values, .env.example for documentation.
Target versions: Next.js 15.x, React 19.x, TypeScript 5.x, Tailwind CSS 3.x.
